recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. The current source satisfies FHIR-16083 after later mustSupport and obligations refactoring; future link or wording cleanup should use a targeted mustSupport/obligations issue rather than reapplying this STU3 examples request.
issue_request: FHIR-16083 was a Published FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive, asking the conformance rules text for profiles marked mustSupport to give examples of what the phrase "many things" could mean, such as expectations to store, display, capture, include in decision logic, or pass data on.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by upstream git-svn commit 7abb8272c08c (svn revision 14213), which replaced the old conformance-rules sentence "as this can mean many things" with the approved examples.
additional_context: Later conformance refactoring moved detailed mustSupport guidance from source/conformance-rules.html into source/obligations.html and source/profiling.html. The latest combined branch actively references conformance-rules.html, profiling.html, and obligations.html from the source hierarchy and documentation index. FHIR-19241 concerns the same old sentence's link/name handling but is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active obligations and profiling pages already include the requested examples, and conformance-rules.html delegates detailed mustSupport guidance to Implementation Obligations.

related_jiras.note: Published mustSupport link/name clarification touching the same conformance-rules sentence; already represented on the combined branch, so it was not duplicated.
Resolved - No Change issue about broader mustSupport expectations found in related searches; it does not alter the examples requested by FHIR-16083.
